نَوءُوشٌ * Strong; overcoming; or prevailing; (K;) possessing might or strength, courage, valour, or prowess. (TA.) You say also, قَدَرٌ نَوءُوشٌ An overcoming decree; as also نَوَّاشٌ. (TA.) See also art. نوش.
فَعَلَهُ نَيءِيشًا * He did it lastly, or latterly, or last of all. (S, A, K.) And جَاءَ نَيءِيشًا He came lastly, or latterly, or last of all: (A:) or slowly, tardily, or late. (TA.) And لَحِقَنَا نَيءِيشًا مِنَ النَّهَارِ He overtook us after the day had declined; (Ibn- 'Abbád, K;) i. e., he held back from us, and then followed us in haste, fearing escape. (TA.) ― -b2- نَيءِيشٌ also signifies Motion in a state of slowness or tardiness. (Zj.) -A2- Th also explains نَيءِيشٌ as signifying Distant or remote. (TA.)
نَوُوشٌ * Strong: (K:) a man possessing might, or strength, courage, valour, or prowess: (S, TA:) as also نَوءُوشٌ, q. v. (TA.) [In two copies of the S, I find the latter only, with ء].
